profile.regional_context: Microsoft's own local.microsoft.com site publishes a dedicated explainer, 'Understanding Microsoft datacenters in Central Washington,' and a 'Quincy Growth' community page via Microsoft Unlocked. Local press (Yakima Herald's 'Future Harvests' series, Wenatchee World) has extensively covered Quincy's transformation into a data center hub, including the 2022 launch of a new Douglas County facility with a public tour event.
profile.disclosure_policy: Microsoft publishes only aggregate worldwide infrastructure statistics and does not publish exact addresses, square footage, or MW capacity for individual Azure data center campuses
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Microsoft's Central Washington data center region, spanning Quincy/Grant County and East Wenatchee/Douglas County. This is one of Microsoft's oldest and most significant hyperscale campuses, dating to roughly 2007.
